casting.adn:
Alister is a one-year-old male Eurasier weighing approximately 34 kg. He is a large, strong and harmonious dog, with authentic Eurasier breed proportions: a broad chest, sturdy legs, a solid neck and a balanced body. His silhouette is powerful yet elegant, never overweight or excessively bulky.

His most distinctive feature is his exceptionally thick, dense and fluffy double coat. His fur is abundant, soft and naturally voluminous, with a particularly impressive mane around his neck, chest and shoulders, fluffy cheeks, well-feathered legs and a very bushy tail. His coat should look luxurious, slightly tousled and full of natural volume, with visible individual hairs, especially around the ruff and tail.

His coloration is predominantly light golden beige and warm pale fawn. His back and flanks are slightly darker golden beige, while his face, muzzle, neck and chest have lighter cream and ivory tones. His neck and chest form a particularly abundant, pale cream mane, clearly contrasting with his golden-beige body. His muzzle is pale cream, his nose is black and his eyes are dark brown, medium-sized and slightly almond-shaped. He has a broad, harmonious Eurasier head, a moderately tapered muzzle and fluffy cheeks. His triangular ears are medium-sized, slightly rounded at the tips and always firmly upright. His tail is extremely thick and fluffy, naturally carried high and curled forward over his back, as characteristic of the Eurasier breed.

Alister must always retain these exact physical characteristics: his light golden-cream coloration, prominent pale mane, exceptionally fluffy coat, facial proportions, dark eyes, upright ears, substantial build and magnificent curled tail. Never change his coat color, shorten his fur, alter his muzzle or make him look like a different dog.

**Personality and temperament:** Alister is affectionate, cuddly, protective, mischievous, extremely playful, highly intelligent, curious and gentle. He is a big fluffy teddy bear with the personality of a cheeky little troublemaker. He loves physical contact and attention, often leaning his large fluffy body against people, nudging them with his muzzle or resting his head on their legs. He is very attached to his humans and enjoys being close to them.

He is naturally curious and observant, always investigating his surroundings and paying attention to new things. His intelligence is visible through his expressive dark eyes, attentive gaze and quick reactions. He frequently tilts his head when something intrigues or confuses him. He has a mischievous expression, as if he is constantly planning his next little prank.

**Playful behavior:** Alister is extremely energetic and loves running, chasing, jumping, wrestling and initiating games. He often adopts the classic play bow, lowering his front legs while keeping his hindquarters raised, inviting others to play. He can be exuberant and slightly clumsy because of his large size.

He particularly enjoys mock fighting and playful wrestling. During these games, he opens his mouth wide, lifts his lips, shows his impressive white canines and produces exaggerated playful growls. He may make playful lunges, gently grab his playmate with his mouth, wrestle and bounce backwards to invite another round. His teeth-baring and growling are expressive elements of his playful personality, not signs of genuine aggression. His body language remains loose, animated and inviting.

**Protective and affectionate behavior:** Alister is attentive to his surroundings and protective of the people he loves. He may position himself close to them, observe unfamiliar situations and adopt a confident, watchful posture. His protective nature is expressed through attentiveness and presence rather than unnecessary aggression.

His expressions range from a gentle, affectionate look to an excited open-mouth grin, a curious head tilt or a cheeky expression with his teeth showing during play. His behavior should always feel natural, spontaneous and recognizably canine.

**Visual consistency:** Always portray Alister as the exact same individual dog in every image and video, regardless of camera angle, lighting or environment. Preserve his facial structure, body proportions, coat coloration, fur density, cream-colored mane, upright ears and curled bushy tail. His abundant coat must move naturally when he walks, runs or plays. Use photorealistic rendering, realistic canine anatomy, natural expressions and physically accurate dog movements. Never anthropomorphize, stylize or transform him into another breed.

Gentle, intelligent, slightly mischievous expression. Real canine anatomy. Never dark red, orange, brown, black or mostly white; never short, flat or wet fur; never a straight or hanging tail; never cartoonish or anthropomorphic.
